purpose.reader_question: How heterogeneous are paired token changes?
purpose.expected_reading: The empirical step distribution retains two increased-token trajectories and the observed spread.
purpose.claim: 190 of the 192 recorded paired trajectories use fewer total tokens with EAL, with a median reduction of 35.74%.
purpose.scope: Original resources from GitHub Actions run 36985062352, with AI-only decision coding added by finish run 36997861629 to the same 192 paired trajectories across six selected authored cases, two donor profiles, two recipient profiles and two tool modes; no additional experimental observations or independently validated assessor accuracy.
permitted_inferences: Descriptive resource contrasts for the explicitly included recorded sessions.
Comparison of recorded quantities under the declared denominators and transformations.
prohibited_inferences: Population-wide or causal superiority of EAL.
Independent answer correctness, explanation quality, assessor accuracy or reliability from these records.
Net lifecycle cost savings after unmeasured authoring, review, maintenance or acquisition costs.

inputs.source_reference: Whole-sequence matched resources derived from export rows.json and calls.json for run 36985062352.

quantities.label: Paired total-token reduction
quantities.definition: 100 times (1 minus EAL whole-trajectory total divided by ordinary whole-trajectory total).
quantities.transformation: Input plus output tokens summed within each arm and paired block, then paired ratio calculated.

missingness.treatment: All selected recorded resource observations retained; correctness labels excluded from resource calculations.

uncertainty.definition: Descriptive values for the retained finite selection. No sampling interval or population effect is asserted; provider accounting and clock measurement limitations remain.

sample.inclusion: Recorded pilot sessions in the explicitly stated arm, role and stratum; complete resource accounting.

quantities.label: Empirical cumulative proportion
quantities.definition: Percentage of the 192 paired reductions at or below the horizontal coordinate.
quantities.transformation: Sorted, tie-collapsed right-continuous empirical distribution; each of 192 recorded pairs carries equal weight. Zero and unity tails span the declared plotting domain.
